property_summary: For any fuzzed value and timestamp, a fallback call on C either reverts or, when it succeeds, must have carried exactly 10 ether and set pastBlockTime to the current block timestamp; the mutant (which dropped the value==10 ether requirement) succeeds on values != 10 ether, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Remove the msg.value == 10 ether requirement so calls with any value are accepted.
